text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the VR recreation of ParisLongchamp 
Racecourse, <chrname> narrowly misses victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The challenges piled up were certainly 
numerous... However, there was enough 
tangible progress to make us feel the 
possibilities ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She is steadily taking a step toward her 
ultimate goal. Looking ahead—this race got 
her fired up for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everyone's reactions also prompted 
some soul-searching. They began to wonder 
if they truly had gained enough 
"supporters"— people who would dare to 
dream alongside them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We must earn more trust from the people of 
Japan. After consulting with <chrname>, a decision 
was made. To deliver results at the 
Japanese Derby—
